died.cause: While leading the German army on the Third Crusade, the Holy Roman Emperor unexpectedly drowned while bathing in the Saleph.

died.name: James A. Moon
died.cause: The 37-year-old blacksmith, self-proclaimed inventor, and American Civil War veteran killed himself with a makeshift guillotine.

died.name: Arthur Gary Bishop
died.desc: American convicted sex offender and serial killer
died.cause: prior to execution by lethal injection
died.last_words: I want to offer again my most profound and heartfelt apologies to my victims' families. I am truly sorry. I have tried my best to empathize with their grief and devastation and I hope they come to know of my concerns and prayers for them.

died.name: Jon Desborough
died.cause: The 41-year-old geography and physical education teacher died due to a chest infection a month after being impaled in the eye with the blunt end of a javelin during an athletics session at the Liverpool College in Mossley Hill, Liverpool. It is believed that he had lost his footing while retrieving the javelin. He remained in a coma until his death.

died.name: Hafez al-Assad
died.cause: to Émile Lahoud, the President of Lebanon
died.last_words: Our destiny is to build a better future for our countries, a safe future for our children. We have to give them something better than we inherited.

born.name: Victor Feguer
